applicability: Semantic understanding evaluations with material blocking questions
Review and promotion gates that could otherwise collapse distinct quality criteria
author: codex:engineering
context: Two actual output snapshots judged by human PO after a frozen bounded generation round; replayed with independent semantic criteria.

evidence.note: Explicit fresh PO judgments and offline typed replay: six pass and two uncertainty fail; source support/coverage pass in recorded corrected outputs. No qualification or promotion.

lesson: Evaluate question materiality independently of source support and aggregate disposition. Preserve per-criterion failure and do not promote a candidate solely from ready/blocked agreement or positive model audit.
limitations: Counterexample establishes insufficiency of the shortcut, not a frequency estimate or universal failure of any model.
Applies to the recorded intent-analysis scope; different target requirements may make a similar question material.
resolution: Stored full criterion-specific human judgments and replayed them offline, retaining uncertainty failure despite matching case disposition and positive citation support.
summary: Recorded counterexamples: eight v3.3 dispositions match expectations, but PO rejects uncertainty in two. Supported questions can still be inappropriate blockers.
title: Disposição correta e citações sustentadas não certificam materialidade
